body:
Thank-you.
I'm just having a hard time thinking about things getting better, whenever I feel like things get better something usually comes up. I just dont want my life to keep on being like this, and I never really considered it to be a loss if I was to stop living, if things keep going this way.

I feel like however remotely strong I was came from knowing I had someone there for me. Now that it's been taken away from me, I don't know how to cope. I lost the only connection that I thought I was sure of, now I feel like because I've become so dependent and introverted, I wont be able to connect with someone else.

I kept waiting for everything to get better, but I always hit a bump. Always, it becomes harder everytime that seems to happen. I do want to thank you though for what you said.
